//: These settings are easier to change in-game! Mod List -> Followers Teleport Too -> Config

Enable Followers Teleport Too.//: Whether Followers Teleport Too is enabled. When disabled, none of its features run and its other settings are hidden. Takes effect after a restart.

disableFollowerDamageAfterTeleport.//: When enabled, disables damage for followers shortly after a teleport. This can prevent fall damage or suffocation from an estimate target position.

durationInSecondsDamageShouldBeDisabled.//: How long in seconds damage should be disabled for after a teleport when disableFollowerDamageAfterTeleport is enabled. min: 0, max: 86,400

followerSearchRadiusInBlocks.//: How far around the player in blocks followers are taken along on a teleport. min: 1, max: 256

followerTypesThatStayBehind.//: A comma separated list of entity ids that never teleport with their owner, for example 'minecraft:nautilus,cobblemon:pokemon'.

followersFollowIntoOtherDimensions.//: Whether followers also come along when a teleport takes the player into another dimension.

allaysTeleportToo.//: Whether allays that like the player (after being given an item) teleport along as well.

mountTeleportsToo.//: Whether the mount the player is riding teleports along, with the player put back on it.
